claim: Shows client commitment, committed subcontractor cost, and expected margin in one job chain
where: landing live preview, demo margin slip, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; open Autumn launch films; assert $24,000 - $14,500 = $9,500 and 39.6%

claim: Warns when committed cost puts expected margin below the job's floor
where: landing product preview, demo job register, demo margin slip, README
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; add a $6,000 commitment to Autumn launch films; assert the written alert identifies the new commitment and says margin is $1,300 below the 20% floor

claim: Keeps scope approval and client invoice status beside the same job
where: landing how-it-works section, demo chain workspace
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; approve the pending scope revision and mark its linked client milestone sent; reload and assert both states remain on that demo job

claim: The sample demo needs no account
where: landing first-screen facts, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /?demo=1; assert a seeded job register is usable without redirecting to CIAM or showing an account gate

claim: Demo changes are discarded when the sample is reset
where: landing first-screen facts, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh /demo workspace; change a commitment; choose Reset demo and confirm; assert original sample values return and the prior demo workspace identifier is no longer accepted

claim: Studio costs $79 per agency each month and Portfolio costs $159 per agency each month
sandbox: fresh landing page; assert both named monthly prices and their active-job limits are visible, and no purchase action is shown before M2 billing ships

claim: Each demo workspace is isolated and expires within 24 hours
sandbox: create two fresh API contexts; mutate one workspace; assert the other remains unchanged and the issued expiry is no more than 24 hours

claim: The public site has no analytics, remote fonts, third-party scripts, or advertising
sandbox: record every request through a landing-to-demo mutation flow and assert the product origin is the only origin

claim: A host-only HttpOnly cookie identifies the demo workspace and is Secure on HTTPS
sandbox: provision through a simulated HTTPS ingress and assert Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and no Domain attribute

claim: Demo workspaces persist across application replicas
sandbox: two independent application states use the same durable store; create on one, read and mutate on the other, then read the change on the first

claim: The server starts with only PORT and defaults to port 8080
sandbox: spawn the compiled server with a cleared environment and only PORT, then assert /health returns 200

claim: Web responses include the product security-header policy
sandbox: request the landing page and assert CSP, HSTS, MIME, referrer, permissions, and frame protections

claim: Demo API routes enforce request limits using the ingress client address
sandbox: exceed provisioning and global API allowances with X-Forwarded-For; assert 429 and Retry-After

claim: Every demo API response, including errors, uses Cache-Control: no-store
sandbox: assert a successful demo response and an invalid demo error response both carry no-store
request an unknown path and assert the HTTP status is 404

claim: Hashed production assets use immutable caching
sandbox: request a hashed asset and assert a one-year immutable Cache-Control policy

claim: The service exposes JSON readiness and Prometheus metrics endpoints
sandbox: assert /ready returns JSON 200 and /internal/metrics returns Prometheus text
